scope: Actual local/S3 DuckLake-PG signed-body equivalence, separate reader, selected precommit/missing-object/restore cases, corrected S3/PG boundary probes and CH MV counterexamples. Not product, native Rust, WAN, host-loss or capacity qualification.

body_experiment.cache: uncontrolled shared host caches; not cold-cache or WAN throughput

catalog_copy.scope: same-server fresh PG database, no writers/maintenance; not off-host recovery

restored_catalog_and_objects.scope: same-host alternate prefix and fresh catalog; not host-loss or live migration

readonly_catalog.scope: role grants only; loopback trust authentication is not authenticated isolation

catalog_closure_and_listing.scope: same-host two-family path/metadata closure; source remains accessible; no live backup barrier

limits: No load rerun or scientific-data mutation
No independent-host, source-denied, power-loss or durability-class qualification

clickhouse_mv.scope: Three bounded engine-semantics counterexamples with literal expected answers; not product correctness, throughput, crash recovery or MV rejection in general.

expiry_polling.interpretation: Fixture orchestration only, not a latency benchmark

upstream_source_review.claim: Selective upstream source inspection, not a full DuckLake or DuckDB/httpfs audit.
upstream_source_review.hash_semantics: Hashes identify the complete pinned files; partial-range entries do not claim full comprehension.

findings.finding: Reviewed native insertion/file metadata exposes paths, sizes, row counts and stats, not an application full-file SHA. Qualified persistence is distinct from checksum capture.
findings.disposition: Revised archive contract separates optional initial SHA capture and mandatory verified backup hashes from native publication/protection.

findings.finding: Old periodic multipart payload allowed aligned wrong-offset range reads to match; LIST recorded output without expected closure comparison.
findings.disposition: New standalone verifier uses position-dependent bytes, complete readback, cross-part/end and invalid ranges, and catalog-selected LIST/HEAD membership; remote execution NOT_RUN by this reviewer.

findings.finding: Original child was killed after INSERT and before COMMIT; this does not test interrupted upload or ambiguous COMMIT acknowledgement.
findings.disposition: Keep this evidence scope; new verifier explicitly excludes those cases.

findings.finding: Original dump/closure copy assumes external quiescence, and restore retains source access.
findings.disposition: New verifier compares source/restored snapshot and both family closures, but claims neither live backup barrier nor source-denied/independent-host restore.

findings.finding: Original reader tests only denied S3 PUT; PG uses loopback trust authentication.
findings.disposition: New verifier checks successful read before S3 PUT/DELETE/multipart denials and PG INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/CREATE TABLE denial with transaction read-only disabled, always rolling back. This is role-grant evidence, not authentication isolation.

findings.finding: Old reader can leave an earlier PASS after a failed reused invocation; probe lacks terminal failure status and faults writes reports non-atomically.
findings.disposition: Preserve original sources and evidence; new verifier requires a fresh identity and atomically records current RUNNING/PASS/FAILED outcome with sanitized errors.

new_verifier.local_validation: PASS negative range/header/truncation oracles, atomic fresh-report/refusal, controlled FAILED report and Python compilation; no service or Tux execution.

known_harness_limits: Initial periodic range payload and unchecked LIST replaced only in separately named stronger probe; initial scope retained.
Initial probe/reader lack robust terminal or fresh-run guards. Fresh actual exit codes0 recorded; no failed rerun promoted to PASS.
prepare_reader first failed on CLI label whitespace after creating key; fixed parser and explicit existing-key recovery. No secret values tracked.
copy_catalog relies on coordinator-established sequential quiescence, not distributed fencing.
Precommit child killed after INSERT, not interrupted upload or ambiguous COMMIT.
Same-host alternate-prefix restore retains source access; later probe compares both full family path closures.
PG loopback trust means privilege test is role enforcement, not authenticated isolation.
Only132 full signed sample rows cryptographically checked; wholepopulation oracle is not allrowcrypto.
not_run: Rust product and real multi-family schema
